resources.string: Tailscale connection
Connect to a private server from this app

Only Jellyfin traffic to the IP below uses this VPN. Other apps keep their normal connection. Use the same IP in your Jellyfin server URL, for example http://100.x.x.x:8096. The server must be reachable in your tailnet. External players and casting do not share this tunnel. MagicDNS and subnet routes are not supported in this version.

Android allows one active VPN per user. Connecting may stop another VPN app. This tunnel only handles Jellyfin traffic to your selected server. It reconnects when you open Jellyfin and can remain active during playback. Use Disconnect to stop it.
